links.outcome: Hazard of FDA recall by availability of published clinical studies at authorization
links.effect: Devices with missing clinical study information had higher recall hazard than devices with published clinical studies (HR, 1.39; 95% CrI, 0.84-3.52); the credible interval includes 1.
links.quote: Devices with missing information regarding clinical studies had a higher hazard of recall than devices with published clinical studies (HR, 1.39; 95% CrI, 0.84-3.52).

unlisted_practices: Strengthened FDA postmarket surveillance using adverse event databases (MAUDE, CORE-MD PMS Tool)

screen.reason: Retrospective cohort study analyzing FDA-authorized AI-enabled medical devices, clinical evidence at authorization, adverse event reports, and recalls. It does not evaluate an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
